dog.description_text:
Bing is ready for walks and playtime!

Bing is a 3-year-old boy who loves people! He is happy to see human friends, then he settles down nicely once the greeting is over.

Bing is a very affectionate dog who enjoys pets and neck scratches. He’ll lean into your pets; keep them coming and you’ll have a BFF! You’ll love seeing his wiggles when he receives attention.

This sweet doggy also enjoys getting out for a walk, taking his time to sniff around and check out everything along the way. He responds well to gentle guidance like baby talk.

Bing has also been doing well in doggy playgroup and has enjoyed playing with other dogs. He may enjoy having another dog in his future home, with the right introduction and match. With his love of sniffy walks and playful, affectionate nature, Bing will make a great companion!

Bing is ready to wiggle into your life. To learn more about Bing, click the “Adopt me” button!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
